children: Saudi-listed SHL Finance Company has secured a SAR 200 million ($53.3 million) credit facility from Saudi Investment Bank.

The company, which provides home and personal loans to individuals, confirmed on Monday that it has renewed its existing Shariah-compliant credit facility with the lender to support its financing portfolio.
The five-year facility was secured with a promissory note, along with customer receivables assigned to the bank as security.
The company’s loan portfolio reached SAR 4.69 billion for the first half of 2026, posting a 4.35% growth from a year ago. Total assets stood at SAR 4.89 billion, up 5.08%.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi’s SHL Finance secures $53.3mln credit facility
